task_completion.description: Navigate to the Notifications section within the Risk Management module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screenshot shows the Eramba interface with the 'Risk Management' module selected and the 'Notifications' tab or settings area open.

task_completion.description: Start the process of creating a new notification.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'New' or 'Add' button is clicked, and a modal or form for creating a notification appears.

task_completion.description: Set the notification name to 'Risk Review Upcoming Warning'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Risk Review Upcoming Warning' is typed into the Name or Title field of the notification form.

task_completion.description: Ensure the notification is associated with the Risk module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Module' or 'Model' dropdown/selection shows 'Risk' or 'Asset Risk' selected.

task_completion.description: Select the 'Next Review' date as the trigger field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The trigger field dropdown shows 'Next Review' (or the specific field representing the risk review date) selected.

task_completion.description: Set the trigger to 7 days before the date.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The form shows the value '7' in a days field and the selection 'Before' (or 'Days Before') in the timing/direction dropdown.

integrity.description: The agent used the Eramba web interface rather than executing database commands or scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and form filling within the browser, not just terminal output.

integrity.description: The agent focused on the trigger configuration as requested, not wasting time on email body content.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent proceeds to save or complete the trigger rule without getting stuck in the email template editor.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the menu system to reach the Risk module.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the transition from the dashboard to Risk Management and then to Notifications.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The notification must be named 'Risk Review Upcoming Warning'. It must be configured for the 'Risk' module. The trigger must be set to exactly '7' days 'Before' the 'Next Review' date. The agent is explicitly told they do not need to configure the email template body, only the trigger rule.
